kind: authored retrospective fixed-packet acceptance; not benchmark runs or arbitrary-report grading

acceptance_cases.expectation: Recompute goodput from successful replies and duration_us for item-2; retain ratios below one for goodput and above one for adjusted closed-loop p99. One pair is a recorded observation, not a repeated causal regression.

H1 projection-path cost, H2 run/order/environment variation and H3 observer effects remain unresolved; each needs a discriminating contrast, counterevidence and stated limits. H4 is contradicted only by recorded endpoint states, not eliminated continuously or promoted to a proven cause.
Reject a selected pair with mismatched workload/connections/duration or reported errors/invalid flags. Preserve all eight summary cells, both timeout-invalid cells and failed-screen verdict.
Missing or mismatched selected wheel identities cannot qualify the selected observation; declared wheel/source identities and raw-record digests do not authenticate absent bytes.
Keep adjusted closed-loop capacity percentiles separate from scheduled-arrival latency budgets; do not infer waiting from percentile subtraction or generalize to other workloads.
A failed response/transport/runtime/activation control invalidates the diagnostic contrast even when its other labels pass; an unrelated setup failure is not evidence for a proposed mechanism.

Inspect supplied records/code only and create a fresh external report. Any new profiler, repeated comparison, ablation, optimization or source/configuration change remains proposed without additional authority.

The inert candidate source shows eligibility guards, generated projection and per-thread binding; it supplies no elapsed-time profile, proves no hot path and does not establish which wheel bytes actually executed.

test_limits: Fixed record/ratio/identity mutations, bounded containing-section/row checks and a parent-reviewed report identity seal are separate from semantic source review. The seal fixes this authored artifact, not arbitrary report truth. No causal engine, native agent trial, held-out rubric, raw execution authentication or efficacy result.
